description: Oscilloscope with a large display and four independent traces; it does not draw polyphonic signals

params.text: Sets the volts per division for that trace, from 5V down to 1mV; at 500mV per division a signal of 10V peak to peak fills the height of the display
Moves that trace up and down the display
Sets that trace to zero volts, muting the input, which lines the trace up against a division marker
Sets the speed of the sweep; slow settings suit LFOs and envelopes and fast ones audio, and a vertical trace marker appears on the slower settings
Freezes the display once the sweep in progress has finished
Chooses what the sweep triggers from: channel 1, 2, 3 or 4, or the external trigger input
Sets the voltage the trigger signal has to cross to start a sweep, anywhere from -10V to 10V
Sets the time after which the sweep runs anyway, when the trigger level has not been crossed
Turns the vertical and horizontal gridlines on and off
Turns the white 0V line across the middle of the display on and off
Turns on and off the 0V line drawn for each trace at the point that trace is displayed around
Turns on and off the readout of peak-to-peak, minimum and maximum voltage and the selected scale, shown for every connected channel

inputs.text: The signal drawn as that channel's trace
The signal the sweep triggers from when TRIGGER is set to EXT.

menu: Centre all — puts every trace on the centre line
Organise — spreads the connected traces apart up the display
